programme.title: Miles Davis, John Scofield, Darryl Jones & Robert Irving III
programme.sub-title: Miles Davis Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1985, legendary American trumpeter Miles Davis gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Davis' influence on the course of jazz cannot be overstated, as he helped shape bebop, modal jazz, hard bop, and electric jazz, and nurtured the talent of influential musicians, including that of seminal saxophonist John Coltrane.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival. Zawinul performed on a huge synthesizer outfit in this concert, recorded live at the Kongressaal in Munich, Germany.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Charlie Haden
programme.sub-title: Charlie Haden & Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1985, American jazz bassist and composer Charlie Haden performed a mesmerizing concert at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Known for his collaborations with free-jazz pioneer Ornette Coleman, Haden brought his own New Liberation Orchestra to the festival.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Les McCann
programme.sub-title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today's broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann's vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including “Just Like Magic”, backed by his wonderful “Magic Band” of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Tom Excell, Pilo Adami, Nick Richards & Finn Booth
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival. This London-based group operates on the intersection of soul and jazz.

programme.title: Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, Andris Nelsons & Kristine Opolais
programme.desc: Andris Nelsons, together with his then-wife, the great soprano Kristine Opolais and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig present a program dedicated to Antonin Dvořák, singing the melodies that the composer hid in all layers of his music with tender, warm, soft colors. Nelsons' tempos remain calm and relaxed, allowing the omnipresent beauty of Dvořák's music to unfold and flood the Gewandhaus. The program opens with Othello, a Concert Overture for Orchestra, Op. 93. Opolais performs “Song to the Moon” from Rusalka, “Songs my Mother Taught Me” from Gypsy Songs, Op. 55/4. This is followed by the Polonaise and 'O, marno, marno to je' from Rusalka and 'Dobrá! Já mu je dám!... Jak je mi?' from Smetana's opera Dalibor. The concert closes with a performance of Dvořák's Symphony no. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95 (“From the New World”). Recorded at the Gewandhaus, Leipzig in May 2017.

programme.title: Mariinsky Theatre Orchestra
programme.desc: The Easter Festival is an internationally renowned event among classical music lovers, traditionally opened in Moscow on Easter Sunday. Each year the Mariinsky Theatre Orchestra and its musical director Valery Gergiev travel across Russia - for the past 10 years now! In 2012, the Mariinsky Theatre Symphony Orchestra under the baton of Valery Gergiev performed the complete cycle of Sergei Prokofiev's symphonies and piano concerti - a composer with whom Maestro Gergiev and the orchestra seemed particularly in tune. Complete program: 'Symphony No.1, Op. 25', 'Piano Concerto No.1', 'Symphony No.5, Op. 100'.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino & Christiane Karg
programme.sub-title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart's swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart's sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: The Everly Brothers
programme.desc: When asked recently for the most memorable moment of his career, Phil Everly replied 'the Albert Hall reunion'. It was September 1983, and ten years on from one of the most acrimonious splits in popular music history, when the Everly Brothers, Don and Phil, took to the stage at London's Royal Albert Hall. The Everlys had dominated the charts in the late fifties and early to mid sixties. Their close harmony singing, acoustic guitars and brilliant songwriting had become instantly recognisable and inspired millions of fans worldwide. On an emotional night in London, the reunion was a success and led to the renewal of their partnership and many more years of success, which continue to this day. Bonus Features: 'Rock 'n' Roll Odyssey' - this documentary, made at the same time as the Albert Hall reunion, tells the complete story of the Everly Brothers up to that point in time. Don and Phil tell their story with additional contributions from Linda Ronstadt, Chet Atkins and many more.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: The Internship

programme.title: Unfaithful
programme.desc: A middle-aged wife and mother has an affair with a handsome younger man, but her husband murders him when he finds out about the affair, and husband and wife must reckon with what happened.

programme.title: All I See is You
programme.desc: A blind woman's relationship with her husband changes when she regains her sight and discovers disturbing details about themselves.

programme.title: My Bakery in Brooklyn
programme.desc: When Chloe and Vivien inherit their aunt's bakery the sparks fly as each has very different ideas for it's future. The solution - a line down the middle of the shop. But will a little romance put some icing on these hot cakes?

programme.title: All I See Is You
programme.desc: Gina (Blake Lively: The Shallows) and husband James (Jason Clarke: Everest) have an almost perfect marriage. After being blinded as a child in a nearly fatal car crash, Gina exclusively depends on James to feel and ‘see' the world around her, and it appears only to solidify their extremely passionate relationship. While the two enjoy a colourful existence living in Bangkok, their relationship is upended when Gina receives a corneal transplant and regains her sight. With her restored vision, Gina experiences the world with a new sense of wonder and independence which James finds threatening. It is only when Gina suddenly begins to lose her sight again that she finally realises the disturbing reality of their marriage... All I See Is You is directed by Hollywood heavyweight Marc Forster (World War Z, Quantum of Solace), and also stars Danny Huston (American Horror Story, Wonder Woman).

programme.title: Ashanti
programme.desc: Dr. Anansa Linderby (Beverly Johnson) is kidnapped in a medical mission in Africa by a slave trader. From this moment, her husband will do anything to recover her and to punish the bad guys, but that will be not an easy task.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit (2015)
programme.desc: In this riotous spin on the mismatched buddy movie, an uptight and by-the-book cop (Reese Witherspoon) tries to protect the gregarious widow (Sofía Vergara) of a drug boss as they race through Texas pursued by crooked cops and murderous gunmen!

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: A Love Song for Bobby Long
programme.desc: A headstrong young woman returns to New Orleans after the death of her estranged mother. Starring: Scarlett Johansson, John Travolta, Gabriel Macht

programme.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
programme.desc: Two friends become entangled in a conspiracy when one of them discovers the boyfriend who dumped her was a spy

programme.title: Keeping Mum
programme.desc: Walter is a pastor who fails to realize that his wife is having an affair and his children are up to no good.

programme.title: Love, Rosie
programme.desc: Best pals Rosie and Alex seem like the perfect couple, something they start to realize after a drunken kiss. However, with Alex set to move away to America will they ever get a chance to make it work?

programme.title: The Party
programme.desc: An intimate gathering of friends goes haywire when an unexpected announcement sets off a chain reaction.

programme.title: The All Together
programme.desc: A frustrated TV producer desperate for a fresh start is held hostage in his home by an American gangster.

programme.title: Gladiatress
programme.desc: 55BC Somewhere In Britain: The Princesses of the Dubonni tribe are three unlikely sisters: Smirgut The Fierce (Fiona Allen), ferocious warrior and full-time mum, Dwyfuc (Doon Mackichan), desperate spinster in search of a hairy husband and Worthaboutapig (Sally Phillips), clumsy village bee-herder. Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Fall of the Krays
programme.desc: From the producers of Rise of the Footsoldier, the brutal brothers from Bethnal Green are back and bloodier than ever. Having secured their empire and their infamy, they must now defend both, as the obsession of a police officer becomes entwined with a burgeoning romance and a dangerous state of mind for Reggie and Ronnie respectively. The electric follow up to the ferocious Rise of the Krays.

programme.title: Battleship Island
programme.desc: Intense, gritty and based on true events, this epic historical transports you to 1945. Following the brutal plight of the innocent Korean labourers, who were forced to mine for coal on Battleship Island during the Japanese colonial era. When US trained independence fighter Mu-young uncovers the disturbing truth, he heads up a plan to evacuate the prisoners. Inescapably brilliant a must see!

programme.title: Discarnate
programme.desc: The producer of Independence Day: Resurgence brings you this spine-tingling descent into the supernatural. A grieving neuro-scientist creates a mind-altering serum that reconnects people to the other side. However it unknowingly attracts a more sinister being. This mind-bending horror stars Thomas Kretschmann (King Kong) Josh Stewart (Interstellar) and Bex Taylor-Klaus (TVs Scream).

programme.title: Redwood
programme.desc: Breakout film at Frightfest Festival and a must-watch for all horror fans! Josh and Beth visit a secluded national park for some quality time. Ignoring the advice of the Park Rangers, they venture off trail and come face to face with Redwood's legendary wildlife. A fresh spin to a well-worn mythology, creating an edge-of-your seat movie to shred your nerves and make you think twice about camping.

programme.title: Where hands touch
programme.desc: In 1944, a 15-year-old girl, daughter of a white German mother and a black African father, meets a member of the Hitler Youth. They become bound by the realization of the horrors being committed around them.

programme.title: 20th Century Women
programme.desc: Set in 1970s Santa Barbara, 20th Century Women is the story of Dorothea (Annette Bening), a single mother, and her son Jamie, as he comes of age at a time brimming with cultural change and rebellion.

programme.title: Joe
programme.desc: Gary, a young lad who is subject to constant physical abuse by his alcoholic father, turns up at Joe's workplace one day, asking for work. Joe takes him in, but it soon becomes clear that the benevolent boss has his own demons to face down...

programme.title: Love Takes Flight
programme.desc: Single mum Lizzy has built boundaries at work and personal life to protect herself. After meeting an impulsive pilot, Charlie, at work, will she be open to change and open herself up to love? (2019)

programme.title: Secrets of Bella Vista
programme.desc: (2022) Uplifting drama starring Rachelle Lefevre. Antiques dealer Tess inherits half of a struggling orchard, discovering a half-sister and family secrets that change her understanding of herself.

programme.title: Fishing for Love
programme.desc: (2021) Romance starring Andrea Brooks and Spencer Lord. When restaurant designer Kendall returns home to Mystic Bay and runs into an alluring new arrival, will he prove to be the perfect catch?

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: A Taste of Love

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother and daughter con team with a devious routine. Max targets wealthy men, lures them into marriage and then Page seduces them, leaving Max to discover their infidelity and reap the huge divorce settlements which tide them over until they target their next victim.

programme.title: Before You Say I Do
programme.desc: George wants to marry Jane, but she swore off marriage after her first husband broke her heart. After wishing he had met Jane before she got married, George winds up ten years in the past.

programme.title: Elsa And Fred
programme.desc: A withdrawn senior experiences life in new ways when he begins spending time with the free-spirited woman who lives across the hall. Starring: Shirley MacLaine, Christopher Plummer, Marcia Gay Harden

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: A celebrated military contractor returns to the site of his greatest career triumphs and re-connects with a long-ago love while unexpectedly falling for the hard-charging Air Force watchdog assigned to him.

programme.title: A Kind of Magic
programme.desc: Meeting at a Halloween party, Matt and Sara have an instant connection, but they agree to not exchange numbers. What they don't realize is that by meeting, they've set in motion events that will change both their lives in magical ways.

programme.title: Christmas Catch
programme.desc: Detective Bennett is on the trail of a thief and goes undercover to find where he's hiding the loot. While undercover, she falls for the supposed thief and begins to suspect that he's been framed. Was he framed? Or are feelings clouding her judgment?

programme.title: Mistletoe Mixup
programme.desc: A workaholic with no time for romance, or the holidays ends up meeting two potential suitors on the same day, but unbeknownst to her, they turn out to be brothers. A sibling squabble commences in this holiday romance.

programme.title: Rosemont
programme.desc: Caught in a blizzard five days before Christmas, pregnant 23-year-old Lisa, and her new friend Brad, a professional snowboarder, take shelter at The Rosemont. A once great winter resort, The Rosemont has seen better days. After losing her daughter and granddaughter, the cantankerous owner Josephine has let it fall into disrepair. But now, stranded by the blizzard, with Lisa giving birth, everyone comes together to provide what they all need most – a family.

programme.title: Enchanted Christmas
programme.desc: When she left Utah as a young widow, Laura Trudeau left behind her father, her love of dance -- and an old heartbreak. Now, she must return home to spearhead the renovation of a derelict hotel, which must be restored in time for a Christmas Eve benefit dance performance. But Laura is shocked to learn that her old love, Ricardo Archuleta, the boy who jilted her for a professional dance career, is the star of the dance benefit. And when his dance partner Taylor walks out on the show for an out-of-town audition, Laura has to step in for her, reawakening her love of the dance, not to mention her old feelings for Ricardo -- a potent combination that has her head spinning.

programme.title: People Presents: Once Upon a Main Street
programme.desc: Amelia buys an available storefront, planning to open a year-round Christmas shop.

programme.title: Ancient Recipes
programme.desc: Sohla's celebrating Oktoberfest by recreating the original pretzel recipe.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas
programme.desc: Santa's handsome but beleaguered stable master John must rush off to Alaska.

programme.title: My Christmas Grandpa
programme.desc: Girl requests cashier as grandpa for Christmas Vivica A. Fox, Bill Cobbs star.

programme.title: Four Christmases and a Wedding

programme.title: People Presents: Once Upon a Main Street
programme.desc: Amelia buys an available storefront, planning to open a year-round Christmas shop.

programme.title: Our Dream Wedding

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Stylist Rose inherits her grandmother's dress shop and reconnects with her old crush, Cole, sparking romance.

programme.title: Once Upon a Date

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori teams up with Million Dollar Matchmaker Patti Stanger to host a series of dates for Morgan, one of her single friends.

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that her mother has hidden this knowledge from her all this time. Then, Jane suddenly disappears. Has she been kidnapped again? Casey must face the demons of her past in order to find her mother before it's too late.

programme.title: Man Of The House (2005)
programme.desc: A hard-edged Texas Ranger is forced to go undercover as an assistant cheerleading coach to protect a group of college cheerleaders after they witness a murder.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: An unlikely group of former '80s video game champions step up to save the world from an alien invasion in this visually spectacular action-adventure.

programme.title: Major League: Back To The Minors
programme.desc: A pitcher is about to be put out to pasture when he is given the opportunity to manage a team.

programme.title: Bad Teacher (2011)
programme.desc: A foul-mouthed seventh grade teacher who is dumped by her sugar daddy starts to pursue a colleague, which provokes conflict with the school's model teacher.

programme.title: Dog Days
programme.desc: “What is it about dogs that brings us so much joy?” Lives are about to change forever, when human and canine paths intertwine in sunny Los Angeles. There's Elizabeth, a news anchor in her 30's, who not only having to deal with a bad breakup, is struggling to cheer up her depressed dog Sam.

programme.title: You, Me and Him
programme.desc: At 40, Olivia is a career-driven lawyer in a stable relationship with her younger girlfriend, Alex. Happy at home and at work, Olivia has no interest in children - at least until she finds herself sobbing uncon­trollably at a friend's pregnan­cy...

programme.title: I Want You Back
programme.desc: Peter and Emma thought they were on the precipice of life's biggest moments – marriage, kids, and houses in the suburbs – until their respective partners dumped them.

programme.title: Gloria Bell
programme.desc: Gloria (Julianne Moore) is a free-spirited divorcée who spends her days at a straight-laced office job and her nights on the dance floor, joyfully letting loose at clubs around Los Angeles. After meeting Arnold (John Turturro) on a night out, she finds herself thrust into an unexpected new romance.

programme.title: Minnesota Clay
programme.desc: In 1883, Clay, a gunfighter with health problems, is wrongfully imprisoned in Drunner Labor Camp. He was framed by Fox, the corrupt sheriff of Mesa Encantada. Fox now extorts the town's people, running a violent protection racket. Clay, determined to clear his name, is approached by bandit Ortiz, who wants him to kill Fox.

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: As tensions rise between settlers and the Assiniboins, Winnetou works to preserve peace. A corrupt oilman, Bud Forrester, stages attacks to spark a war and seize oil-rich Native land. Joined by Old Shatterhand and Lord Castlepool, Winnetou must expose the conspiracy before violence becomes inevitable.

programme.desc: A major robbery spirals out of control when two young men cross paths with ruthless Mexican bandits and a corrupt businessman—both desperate to reclaim the stolen loot. Caught in a deadly chase, the youths face danger, betrayal, and the fight for survival.

He is a cad and bigamist (or, worse, he has seven wives and identities). His female lawyer tries to keep him out of jail, though he prefers incarceration to multiple matrimony.

As the train is leaving on the driver's last run the stoker boards it, followed by the driver's daughter. During the run the old man discovers what he believes to be an illicit love between his daughter and the new stoker, whom he knocks off the cab. He is himself struck down by his former mate, but the girl is also there, and she is faced with the awesome task of bringing the great train safely to a standstill.

In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Derailed [Broadcast Edit]

Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

Freeman adamantly warns the planners of the likelihood of a major avalanche, but they ignore her pleas. As she realizes that a massive whiteout is imminent, Freeman tries to get the citizens of a nearby town to leave, aided by brave helicopter pilot Neal Meekin (Thomas Ian Griffith).

programme.desc: Après qu'un cadavre eut été découvert sur le site de ses plus récentes fouilles, une archéologue se découvre la cible d'un complot.

programme.desc: Une archéologue, consultante pour les futurs acquéreurs d'un château hanté, se retrouve impliquée dans une mystérieuse enquête pour meurtre.

programme.title: Miles Davis, John Scofield, Darryl Jones & Robert Irving III
programme.sub-title: Miles Davis Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1985, legendary American trumpeter Miles Davis gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Davis' influence on the course of jazz cannot be overstated, as he helped shape bebop, modal jazz, hard bop, and electric jazz, and nurtured the talent of influential musicians, including that of seminal saxophonist John Coltrane.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival. Zawinul performed on a huge synthesizer outfit in this concert, recorded live at the Kongressaal in Munich, Germany.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Charlie Haden
programme.sub-title: Charlie Haden & Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1985, American jazz bassist and composer Charlie Haden performed a mesmerizing concert at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Known for his collaborations with free-jazz pioneer Ornette Coleman, Haden brought his own New Liberation Orchestra to the festival.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Les McCann
programme.sub-title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today's broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann's vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including “Just Like Magic”, backed by his wonderful “Magic Band” of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Tom Excell, Pilo Adami, Nick Richards & Finn Booth
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival. This London-based group operates on the intersection of soul and jazz.

programme.title: Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, Andris Nelsons & Kristine Opolais
programme.desc: Andris Nelsons, together with his then-wife, the great soprano Kristine Opolais and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig present a program dedicated to Antonin Dvořák, singing the melodies that the composer hid in all layers of his music with tender, warm, soft colors. Nelsons' tempos remain calm and relaxed, allowing the omnipresent beauty of Dvořák's music to unfold and flood the Gewandhaus. The program opens with Othello, a Concert Overture for Orchestra, Op. 93. Opolais performs “Song to the Moon” from Rusalka, “Songs my Mother Taught Me” from Gypsy Songs, Op. 55/4. This is followed by the Polonaise and 'O, marno, marno to je' from Rusalka and 'Dobrá! Já mu je dám!... Jak je mi?' from Smetana's opera Dalibor. The concert closes with a performance of Dvořák's Symphony no. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95 (“From the New World”). Recorded at the Gewandhaus, Leipzig in May 2017.

programme.title: Mariinsky Theatre Orchestra
programme.desc: The Easter Festival is an internationally renowned event among classical music lovers, traditionally opened in Moscow on Easter Sunday. Each year the Mariinsky Theatre Orchestra and its musical director Valery Gergiev travel across Russia - for the past 10 years now! In 2012, the Mariinsky Theatre Symphony Orchestra under the baton of Valery Gergiev performed the complete cycle of Sergei Prokofiev's symphonies and piano concerti - a composer with whom Maestro Gergiev and the orchestra seemed particularly in tune. Complete program: 'Symphony No.1, Op. 25', 'Piano Concerto No.1', 'Symphony No.5, Op. 100'.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino & Christiane Karg
programme.sub-title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart's swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart's sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: The Killers
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring The Killers.

programme.title: The Everly Brothers
programme.desc: When asked recently for the most memorable moment of his career, Phil Everly replied 'the Albert Hall reunion'. It was September 1983, and ten years on from one of the most acrimonious splits in popular music history, when the Everly Brothers, Don and Phil, took to the stage at London's Royal Albert Hall. The Everlys had dominated the charts in the late fifties and early to mid sixties. Their close harmony singing, acoustic guitars and brilliant songwriting had become instantly recognisable and inspired millions of fans worldwide. On an emotional night in London, the reunion was a success and led to the renewal of their partnership and many more years of success, which continue to this day. Bonus Features: 'Rock 'n' Roll Odyssey' - this documentary, made at the same time as the Albert Hall reunion, tells the complete story of the Everly Brothers up to that point in time. Don and Phil tell their story with additional contributions from Linda Ronstadt, Chet Atkins and many more.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Alabama and Friends
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama in a once in a lifetime concert event, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band. Experience timeless tunes 'Tennessee River', 'Love In The First Degree', 'I'm In A Hurry (And Don't Know Why)', 'My Home's In Alabama', and more.

programme.title: Blue Horizons
programme.desc: Blue Horizons features a diverse set of strikingly blue nature video scenes from places like Hawaii, Mexico, Canada, and California. It is paired with a custom written ambient track by Travis Revell / Relax Moods. ABOUT THE COLOR BLUE: The color blue has a cooling, and soothing effect upon the nervous system, and upon the bloody and bodily organs. "Turquoise is cerebrally calming, and is an effective color for sound sleep. programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

Su estancia en la isla donde viven sus hijos desencadena una crisis que los afecta a todos, pero especialmente a él, porque toma conciencia de su incapacidad para darle a su familia lo que espera de él.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Una noche, James Ballard estrella su coche contra el de Helen y ambos son ingresados en un hospital. Lo sorprendente es que inmediatamente después del choque los dos experimentaron una extraña atracción mutua. A partir de entonces, la vida de James se precipitará hacia un mundo oscuro y prohibido, dominado por el peligro, el sexo y la muerte.

programme.title: Ángel de venganza
programme.desc: En Manhattan, Thana es una mujer tímida y muda que trabaja como costurera en la industria de la moda…

programme.title: Vivir (V.O.S.E.)
programme.desc: Kanji Watanabe es un envejecido burócrata a quien diagnostican una enfermedad en fase terminal. Ante esta desesperada situación, Watanabe se da cuenta del tiempo que ha malgastado en su vida y empieza a recapacitar para encontrar sentido a sus últimos días.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras mujeres
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer próximos a los cuarenta se conocen en una boda en un hotel neoyorkino. Entablarán una conversación llena de ingenio y dobles sentidos en la que cada uno va cercando al otro con la precisión de un felino.

programme.title: Adiós a las armas
programme.desc: El conductor de una ambulancia estadounidense y una enfermera inglesa se enamoran en Italia durante la Primera Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Zeros and Ones
programme.desc: JJ (Ethan Hawke), un soldado norteamericano destinado en Roma, ve saltar por los aires la ciudad del Vaticano a plena noche. Así se embarcará en un heroico viaje para descubrir y enfrentarse a un enemigo desconocido que está amenazando al mundo entero. Pero ¿qué papel jugará en todo esto su hermano, un radical revolucionario que se encuentra en búsqueda y captura?

programme.title: Life of Brian
programme.desc: Brian nace en un pesebre de Belén el mismo día que Jesucristo. Un cúmulo de desgraciados y tronchantes equívocos le harán llevar una vida paralela a la del verdadero Hijo de Dios.

programme.title: Mi pie izquierdo
programme.desc: Ganadora de Oscars (1989): Mejor Actor y Actriz secundaria. Basada en la biografía de Christy Brown. Aquejado de parálisis cerebral, gracias a su tenacidad y al incondicional apoyo de su madre, consiguió su integración en la sociedad.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos hallan oro en el desierto australiano la codicia los lleva a arriesgarlo todo.

programme.title: Un final inesperado
programme.desc: Kara y Tyler planean casarse, pero la reaparición de su ex tras rehabilitación amenaza su relación.

programme.title: Presa
programme.desc: Una veterinaria del zoo debe encabezar la caza de un monstruoso león que aterroriza la ciudad de Ámsterdam.

programme.title: El último día en la Tierra
programme.desc: La Luna Roja va hacia la Tierra. Un astronauta huye con una joven mientras el planeta está en peligro.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo
programme.desc: Caminaremos hasta la cima de Snowdon, la montaña más alta del Parque Nacional de Snowdonia.

programme.title: Retornados
programme.desc: En un mundo post-zombi, donde los infectados viven vidas normales, su medicación se está agotando.

programme.title: La isla de Bergman
programme.desc: Una pareja de cineastas se retira a la isla de Fårö, donde vivió el director sueco Ingmar Bergman, en busca de inspiración para sus próximas películas. Según avanza el verano, aumenta su fascinación por los misteriosos paisajes de la isla, y la frontera entre realidad y ficción se desdibuja.

programme.title: Petite Maman
programme.desc: Nelly tiene 8 años y acaba de perder a su abuela. Mientras ayuda a sus padres a vaciar la casa en la que su madre creció, explora el bosque que la rodea. Allí conoce a otra niña de su edad y surge una preciosa amistad. Entre juegos y confidencias, desvelarán un fascinante secreto.

programme.title: Los invasores (The Recall)
programme.desc: Charlie enciende el televisor para averiguar qué son unos cúmulos de nubes anti-naturales que hay en el cielo de su casa, la cual comparte con sus amigos para pasar el ﬁn de semana.

programme.title: Dark Was the Night
programme.desc: En el remoto pueblo de Maiden Woods comienzan a sucederse una serie de sanguinarios crímenes. Unas extrañas huellas parecen señalar a algún tipo de animal como principal sospechoso. Mientras la población vive atemorizada por los acontecimientos, el Sheriff Paul Shield investiga el caso.

programme.title: Las ocho montañas
programme.desc: Pietro es un chico de ciudad. Todos los años pasa el verano con su familia en el pueblo de Bruno, el último niño de una localidad de montaña olvidada. Con el paso de los años, Bruno se mantiene fiel a su montaña, mientras que Pietro viene y va.

programme.title: 1945: Tres mujeres
programme.desc: 1945, un tren con prisioneros judíos queda varado cerca de una aldea alemana ocupada por el Ejército Rojo. En un contexto de profunda desconfianza, desesperación y venganza, surge una inesperada amistad entre tres mujeres: una francotiradora rusa, una alemana y una judía-holandesa.

programme.title: Inquebrantable
programme.desc: Eric Liddell, el primer medallista olímpico de China y uno de los mejores atletas de Escocia, regresa a una China devastada por la guerra.

programme.title: Campeón
programme.desc: Un jugador de futbol americano universitario, que en su último año de estudios antes de dar el salto a la liga profesional, le diagnostican una grave enfermedad a la que tendrá que hacer frente.

programme.title: Dulce como el amor
programme.desc: Jessie Dale es la tercera generación de panaderos y ama su pastelería más que a nada en el mundo. Unos desarrolladores amenazan con comprar el edificio y obligarla a irse, por lo que se ve en la obligación de hacer todo lo posible para salvar la panadería.

programme.title: Perdido en Florencia
programme.desc: Eric Lombard es un americano con el corazón roto en una fase de su vida en la que tras tomar varias decisiones, decide viajar a Florencia. Allí tratará de descifrar que es lo que más desea, si seguir jugando al fútbol y continuar con su antiguo amor o darle un cambio de rumbo a su vida.

programme.title: Más que un sueño
programme.desc: Una joven poco ortodoxa que abre su propia floristería puramente por intuición, conoce al hombre con el que -literalmente- siempre ha soñado. Pero luego se presenta un nuevo hombre soñado.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Dublín, 1904, James Joyce conversa con Nora Barnacle, una empleada de hotel recién llegada de Galway. Ella lo encanta con su manera franca y desinhibida y, en poco tiempo, él la convence para que lo acompañe a Trieste.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: Un manitas con problemas matrimoniales se encuentra con un ama de casa con los mismos.

programme.title: El duelo del siglo
programme.desc: Algunas victorias deportivas van más allá de la consecución de un título. Algunas pasan a la historia. La película sigue el enfrentamiento más dramático y legendario de la historia del ajedrez: la partida de 1978 entre Karpov y Korchnoi.

programme.title: Todas las cosas buenas
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real sucedida en Nueva York en los 80. En los '70, David Marks (Ryan Gosling), el hijo de un gran propietario de bienes inmuebles, se casa con una hermosa estudiante de clase trabajadora, Katie McCarthy (Kirsten Dunst). Tras la boda, se van a vivir al campo, pero bajo la influencia del magnate regresan a la ciudad. Ella vuelve a la facultad de medicina al tiempo que trata de entender los cambios de estado de ánimo de su marido y su falta de voluntad para tener hijos.

programme.title: El hombre más enfadado de Brooklyn
programme.desc: La doctora Sharon Gill, que está haciendo una sustitución, le comunica a un paciente que le quedan sólo 90 minutos de vida. Cuando se da cuenta de su error, trata desesperadamente de localizar a ese hombre, que recorre frenéticamente la ciudad para tratar de corregir todos los errores que ha cometido en su vida.

programme.title: El secreto de la mansión
programme.desc: Una economista de éxito en Wall Street regresa a Inglaterra con su nuevo marido y su hijo de cinco años de edad. Pero su cambio…

programme.title: Some Voices
programme.desc: Un joven enigmático y encantador, sale de un psiquiátrico y queda al cuidado de su super protector hermano.

programme.title: Vidas Criminales
programme.desc: Secuestro se complica cuando el esposo no paga.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Rockero rescata a su esposa secuestrada en Chile.

programme.title: Un Hombre Solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo venido a menos intenta superar tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: In the Loop
programme.desc: El Presidente de EE.UU. y el Primer Ministro británico deciden iniciar una guerra y prometen ser rápidos. El Secretario de Estado británico para el desarrollo internacional, respalda accidentalmente la acción militar en horario de máxima audiencia en televisión, ganando muchos amigos en Washington.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Cameron Crowe ('Casi famosos') nos presenta la historia de un ingeniero espacial (Bradley Cooper) que regresa a su hogar. Allí acepta trabajar con una piloto (Emma Stone) que le ayudará a descubrir una mejor versión de sí mismo.

programme.title: Un robo inesperado
programme.desc: Una pareja de ladrones organiza un gran golpe en Los Ángeles para saldar una deuda con un gánster británico.

programme.title: La muerte de Stalin
programme.desc: La noche del 2 de marzo de 1953 murió un hombre. Ese hombre es Josef Stalin, dictador, tirano, carnicero y Secretario General de la URSS. Y si juegas bien tus cartas, el puesto ahora puede ser tuyo.

programme.title: El Clan De Los Rompehuesos
programme.desc: Paul Crewe, un jugador de fútbol americano, y Nate Scarboro, entrenador y antiguo campeón, se encuentran cumpliendo condena en la misma prisión. Juntos deciden formar un equipo que juegue contra el de los guardias.

programme.title: Rough Night
programme.desc: En Rough Night, una noche de mucha fiesta toma un giro divertidamente oscuro cuando cinco mejores amigas matan accidentalmente a un estríper masculino.

programme.title: Superfumado
programme.desc: Un par de drogadictos se convierten en objetivo de una banda cuando uno de ellos presencia un asesinato y huye con su compañero de quienes desean silenciarles para siempre.

programme.title: La leyenda del Llanero Solitario
programme.desc: El único Ranger de Texas (Klinton Spilsbury) superviviente de una emboscada organizada por el líder de los forajidos, el Mayor Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd), vuelve para contraatacar como un gran héroe del western enmascarado, El Llanero Solitario.

programme.title: Las águilas negras de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Cuando los comanches se ponen en pie de guerra, los colonos se refugian en la Roca del Águila comandada por el Capitán Jackson.

programme.title: Frontera de tormentas
programme.desc: Tras escapar de la banda de los Silers, Winnetou y su hermana llegan a Miramonte junto a Old Firehand. Mientras la banda prepara un ataque para liberar a uno de los suyos, Old Firehand descubre un importante secreto familiar. Unidos, deberán organizar la defensa del pueblo frente a la inminente amenaza.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (tal para cual)
programme.desc: La trama muestra como Trinidad descubre que Bambino ha sido injustamente condenado a muerte por el asesinato de dos pistoleros. Logrará sustituir al verdugo y salvarle de la muerte, huyendo con él en busca de los verdaderos autores del delito.

programme.title: Juan Moreira
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, el arriero Juan Moreira es un buen gaucho y trabajador que, como muchos otros, es objeto de abusos y humillaciones por parte de los poderosos: los terratenientes de la policía.

programme.title: Un deseo en Nashville
programme.desc: Un joven cantante de country sueña con llegar a Nashville y conquistar a la animadora más guapa del instituto. Cuando su carrera empieza a despegar al mismo tiempo que su relación, debe elegir entre la música y el amor en una historia sobre el primer romance, el destino y el paso a la madurez.

programme.title: October Gale
programme.desc: Una doctora invita en su casa a un hombre misterioso en su remota cabaña con una herida de bala.

programme.title: The Take Down
programme.desc: The Take Down sigue a Jack, un sicario de Londres, que recibe una segunda oportunidad de salvar a su hija. En una carrera contrarreloj llena de acción, debe enfrentarse a enemigos letales, donde cada decisión es cuestión de matar o morir.

programme.title: Locas y Atrapadas
programme.desc: Cinco mujeres quedan atrapadas en un ascensor y comparten historias de sus vidas.

programme.title: The winter lake
programme.desc: Después de hacer un descubrimiento sombrío en un lago estacional, un adolescente retraído descubre la verdad sobre sus vecinos, un padre y una hija que albergan secretos siniestros.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: Bajo un manto de estrellas
programme.desc: En 1936, el vetusto convento de Calatrava era la sede de la casa de estudios mayores, el noviciado y la escuela apostólica de humanidades de los dominicos.

programme.title: Re-emigrantes
programme.desc: Los Briones deciden regresar a su pueblo de origen, Villanueva de los Molinos, Una vez allí, Santiago, y sus hijos tratarán de adaptarse a su nueva vida realizando todo tipo de trabajos.

programme.title: Una película póstuma
programme.desc: Un hombre de ciudad recibe la llamada de la mujer a la que amó y emprende un viaje clandestino para reencontrarse con ella en una comunidad proscrita asentada en la cumbre de una montaña. Dos guías sucesivos le llevan a su destino: el reencuentro con una historia que no ha podido olvidar.

programme.title: La vida abismal
programme.desc: Ferrán es un joven que malvive de trabajos esporádicos y de jugar a las cartas. En una partida, conoce al Chino, un jugador de aspecto imponente, y contrae una deuda con él. Se hacen amigos y la vida de Ferran cambia.

programme.title: Una piraña en el bidé
programme.desc: Julia quiere que sus padres separados, vuelvan a juntarse. Para ello consigue que su padre y su niñera África, que viven juntos, se peleen, y que África conquiste a Alejo, el compañero de su madre. Pero su madre se ha enamorado de Jorge, con el que espera un hijo.

programme.title: Sons of Liberty
programme.desc: An elite team of scientists and soldiers unite to thwart a terrorist plot to detonate a nuclear weapon along the Gulf Coast.

programme.title: SAGA: La maldición de la sombra
programme.desc: Un grupo formado por una elfa, un hombre y un orco emprenderán una aventura para evitar que una orden secreta lleve al mundo de Saga a la oscuridad.

programme.title: Un misterio para Aurora Teagarden: El juego del gato y el raton
programme.desc: Aurora Teagarden volvera a enfrentarse a la resolucion de un nuevo crimen cuando un misterioso criminal empieza a dejarle enigmaticas pistas.

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a bloodthirsty, flesh-eating breed of monsters who are ravaging the East Coast of the United States.

programme.title: Disembodied
programme.desc: The 90's VHS cult classic is now in HD! Connie Sproutz, a likeable young woman with the sad problem of a spore-generating deformity on her face which causes difficulties in her day-to-day life such as dissolving into a gelatinous mass anyone who is to be devoured by the neural parasite that inhabits her skull, which is empty due to the fact that she stores her brain in a jar beside her bed.

programme.title: Rabia
programme.desc: Una mujer desarrolla el gusto por la sangre humana después de una cirugía plástica experimental, y sus víctimas se convierten en zombis sedientos de sangre, lo que lleva a una epidemia en toda la ciudad.

programme.title: Cut off (esp)
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: Santos y soldados
programme.desc: Cuatro soldados estadounidenses y un británico durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial luchan por regresar al territorio aliado después de ser separados de las fuerzas estadounidenses durante la histórica Masacre de Malmedy.

programme.title: Gagarin, Pionero del Espacio
programme.desc: El 12 de abril de 1961, el cosmonauta soviético Yuri Gagarin despegó en un cohete Vostok y orbitó alrededor de la Tierra durante 108 minutos. Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Un cártel de droga colombiano se alía con un grupo de Triads de Hong Kong y con el sicario más atactivo del planeta para enviar dos toneladas de cocaína a Australia y a China.

programme.title: Los Cuatro Guerreros
programme.desc: Cuatro valientes caballeros intentarán dar caza a un malvado depredador casi invencible. Su misión es capturar al secuestrador de todos los hombres y niños de una aldea devastada.

programme.title: Mátalos suavemente
programme.desc: Una potentísima historia de mafias contemporáneas, puesta en imágenes con una lírica abrumadora. Tres criminales, no demasiado inteligentes, deciden dar un nuevo golpe: atracar una partida de cartas controlada por la mafia. Con una pinta ridícula inician el robo y milagrosamente logran cometerlo.

programme.title: En nombre de la justicia
programme.desc: Un sheriff retirado de los Rangers de Texas debe volver a las armas cuando una peligrosa banda de moteros toma su pequeño pueblo y amenaza con sembrar el caos y la violencia.

programme.title: Los mercenarios
programme.desc: Barney Ross es un veterano de guerra que ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate. Siguiendo un encargo que proviene de altas esferas gubernamentales, el grupo se dirige a una república latinoamericana con la misión de derrocar a un dictador despiadado.

programme.title: El Ultimo Soldado Americano
programme.desc: Tras caer prisionero en la jungla de Vietnam, el "Comandante" consigue escapar.

programme.title: Amenaza Terrorista
